**Getting a Gas Extractor T1:**
- Its blueprint unlocks automatically once you hit 100.00 mPa of Pressure — it's a Pressure-stage milestone, not a random blueprint chip drop, so you don't need luck for this one.

**Where:** the **Volcanoes/Lava Pits biome**, southeast corner of the map south of the Wasteland and Meteor Field, east of the Waterfall. - Loose chunks spawn on the ground throughout the volcanic terrain — just walk around and pick it up.
- Watch your step: some of that terrain looks like partially-cooled lava and will hurt you if you step on it, and obsidian can spawn right on top of that hazard terrain — keep your health topped off before grabbing pieces there.
- For automated mining, a T2 or T3 Ore Extractor placed in the biome will pull it, but placement is finicky — it has to be near the actual big obsidian chunk/pillar, not just generally in the region — so if it's not showing up as an extractable option, try moving the extractor closer to the obelisks specifically.

Obsidian is what the Map microchip needs, so this tracks — and it's found in only one biome.

**Where:** the **Volcanoes/Lava Pits biome**, southeast corner of the map south of the Wasteland and Meteor Field, east of the Waterfall. Look specifically around the giant obsidian obelisk/pillar formations in that area — you'll find a much heavier concentration of ore right around those shards than scattered elsewhere in the biome.

**How to get it:**
- Loose chunks spawn on the ground throughout the volcanic terrain — just walk around and pick it up.
- Watch your step: some of that terrain looks like partially-cooled lava and will hurt you if you step on it, and obsidian can spawn right on top of that hazard terrain — keep your health topped off before grabbing pieces there.
- For automated mining, a T2 or T3 Ore Extractor placed in the biome will pull it, but placement is finicky — it has to be near the actual big obsidian chunk/pillar, not just generally in the region — so if it's not showing up as an extractable option, try moving the extractor closer to the obelisks specifically.
- Note: the volcanoes are mostly dormant early on, and a lot of the obsidian won't fully appear until lava starts flowing — so if your terraforming hasn't reached that stage yet, supply may be limited until it does.
